records.subject: You're in -- let's get Pioneer Media set up
records.body:
Hi Jordan,

Thanks for joining Wrenfield. If this is your first project-management tool for the team, the biggest adjustment is usually just getting into the habit of logging tasks here instead of a doc or a chat thread.

Happy to help with that transition.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

records.text: :tada: New signup: *Pioneer Media* just joined on the pro plan!

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, one invite sent but no first project or key milestone; customer's only reply was a non-committal "Will do, thanks" [email:6f1fa5a3] after two nudges [email:e14d4036, email:fdf3dc69]. Some engagement (invite, Pro plan, reply) but no setup momentum, 8 days left. No tickets.

draft.subject: Getting Pioneer Media's first project going
draft.body:
Hi Jordan,

Thanks for the quick reply earlier — glad the invite went through. The one thing still outstanding is getting a first project started, and that's usually the step that makes everything else click: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, so it's a short exercise rather than a big setup.

If it's easier with company, I'm happy to hop on a 10-minute call this week and get that first project created with you — just tell me a time that works.

Best,
Chidi
